Titles.eng: Touch: Ace Without a Number on His Back

Summaries.eng: Tatsuya and Kazuya, the twin brothers of the Uesugi family. He went on to Meisei Gakuen High School with his childhood friend Minami Asakura, but the three had a delicate love triangle. Kazuya and Minami avoided joining the baseball club, which is treated like an official couple, but on the day of the baseball club's district qualifying final, Kazuya Ace did not appear.
Summaries.jpn: 上杉家の双子の兄弟、達也と和也。幼なじみの浅倉南と共に明青学園高等部に進学するが、3人は微妙な三角関係にあった。和也と南が公認カップルのように扱われる野球部への入部を避けた達也だったが、野球部の地区予選決勝戦の日、エースの和也が現れず…。

Aliases: 劇場版『タッチ背番号のないエース』
